claim_ceiling: TF-IDF family fully evaluated at 174k: adversarial gates pass for 5/8 citation-based reps; citation heritage recall@10 < 0.06 for all; label normalization helps citation reps (+4-10%) but harms full-text reps (-30-34% zoom_fine); boilerplate resistance fails for all 8; hierarchy_coherence fails all (max purity 0.465 < 0.7); dense embeddings required for fractal-map completion (3/26 years complete, 11.5%)
evidence_summary: Recomputed formal suite (8 reps, exact k-NN on 2000 stratified subsample): 5/8 PASS both adversarial gates (cited_decisions_tfidf, outcome_tfidf, regeste_tfidf, hybrid_0.5, hybrid_0.7), 3/8 FAIL both (full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_hybrid_0.5, regeste_hybrid_0.7). Recomputed citation heritage (8 reps, 1020 pairs exact cosine): all FAIL AUC>0.6 & recall@10>0.2 (best AUC=0.897 full_text, recall@10=0.053). Recomputed v17b label normalization: 5/8 citation reps improve 4-10% purity across hierarchy/zoom/legal_area; 3/8 full-text reps degrade 30-34% on zoom_fine (uniform_improvement_or_matching=false). Boilerplate resistance: 8/8 FAIL (resistance_score -0.57 to -0.82). Nesting defect confirmed (max 0.663). HNSW artifact fixed (exact k-NN restores jurist_pairwise 0.71-0.80 vs collapsed 0.122). No leakage/gaming detected. Negative results honestly reported. Minor discrepancies: citation heritage AUC values differ between report (137k HNSW) and embeddings script (1020 exact); regeste hybrid language dominance differs between report and suite summary. Non-blocking.
